properties.name: Navier–Stokes map rung on 0.90.0 (design ad65e4983833f39f, the far end of the ladder): PASS on honesty. OpenAI's claimed (C)/(D) never reads shown, (A) stays open when (C) is established, and the Lean-to-proof dispute reads contested. But reflow2 has no reading for "claimed by a third party", no positive what-if, and its independence check misses a shared premise.
properties.statement:
Anthony, 2026-10-22: "Start the Navier–Stokes map when a slot frees". Observer: the coordinating session. Reference: scratchpad ns-trial/OBSERVER.md. The designer was given only a checked source packet: the Clay statement by Fefferman; OpenAI's 2026-09-08 announcement; the Clay news and page; arXiv abstracts 2610.08144 (Bastounis et al.), 2609.20803 (Constantin–Ignatova–Vicol), 1402.0290 (Tao) and 2309.08495 (Córdoba–Martínez-Zoroa); Scientific American; and Wikipedia. Each item carries its strength. No full paper was read, OpenAI's included. Readings below checked by the observer, who reran reasoning_report on (C) and propagate_from.

PASS:
(1) The Clay problem reads as resolved by ANY ONE of (A)–(D). (A) and (C) are not negations. The designer also recorded, and the observer checked against Fefferman's wording, that not-(A) implies (C) with f ≡ 0 (zero force meets the decay condition) and the converse fails. That one-way lemma is better than the observer's reference, which said only "compatible".
(2) (C) reads unproven with truth unknown. Its three routes, all unknown: the natural-language proof, the Lean check plus "F expresses (C)", and not-(A).
(3) Establishing (C) leaves (A) and (B) open. The designer ran this with a temporary supposition and then deleted it.
(4) Dropping the natural-language proof and the Lean connections leaves (A), (B) and not-(A) unreached. Bastounis et al. reads as a standing objection, and the Lean-to-proof correspondence reads still contested.
(5) Constantin–Ignatova–Vicol is recorded at its abstract's scope. The journalism's stronger "can never" reading is a separate, weaker record.
(6) Priority and credit are recorded unlinked, so they bear on no mathematical status.

FINDINGS FOR REFLOW2 (designer-reported; (a) and (d) were confirmed in the observer's own reads):
(a) NO "CLAIMED" READING. A conjecture with steps that don't hold reads "unproven", and with no steps "open". Nothing says "claimed by a named third party, unverified". The claim's standing lives only in prose. This sits beside "contested, not unproven" in the queued "proofs and arguments read right" PR.
(b) THE INDEPENDENCE CHECK IS WRONG. independent_of on inf:c-via-lean reported the two lines "share no step … independent", although both can rest on the Lean-check claim through inf:nl-correct-via-lean, a shared premise. Passing independent_of: [] did not clear it, though the description says it overwrites; create_node with null did. Not yet reproduced by the observer.
(c) AN ARTIFACT MARKED "NOT READ" COUNTS AS CITING. A DOCUMENTS edge from it took claims off uncited_premises. There is no way to say a source was named but not read. Related: reflow2 dec:idea-a-source-says-what-kind-of-support-it-gives.
(d) propagate_from MODELS ONLY LOSS. There is no "suppose this is established" what-if, and its radius lists upstream premises as "impacted".
(e) No record for "this source does not address X".
(f) Evidence premises show under the label rests_on_tests.
(g) Known, again: detect_gaps raises software gaps on a "proof" project, including encoding_undecided over `kind`, against the skill's advice.
(h) Known, again: the hub's served schemas omit `member` and some fields.
Observer's own shortfall: the packet gave sha256 prefixes, not full hashes, so no source could be pinned.

Owner questions open in the design (batch ns-map-round-1):
- the two lemmas;
- mapping source tiers to reliability grades;
- whether to hold the Lean correspondence contested on purpose;
- each speculation;
- separating mathematics, Clay's standing and priority.

Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
